newsitem.title: USA: Owens Corning says files 2nd suit vs lab.
newsitem.headline: Owens Corning says files 2nd suit vs lab.

text.p: Owens Corning said on Thursday it filed a second lawsuit against a pulmonary function testing laboratory, and its owner, charging an extensive scheme to defraud the company in connection with asbestos litigation.

The first lawsuit was filed in June, 1996, when Owens Corning reported an ongoing investigation of pulmonary function testing laboratories that allegedly generated false medical test results in order to file fraudulent medical claims against the company, it said.

The new lawsuit, filed January 22 in U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Mississippi, alleged that the scheme was carried out by a pulmonary function testing laboratory operating in Alabama, Indiana, Mississippi and Ohio, it said.
The company did not immediately provide the name of the laboratory.
